audit.initial_spread_sign_conflicts_note: provider rows whose initial_spread sign disagrees with fav_side, counted over every event; reported, never resolved (the rule pins the stored home-signed value)

total.interpretable_note: NOT INTERPRETABLE: coefficients fit on select n = 4; the pinned test is untestable (no open values in the select window)

spread.interpretable_note: NOT INTERPRETABLE: coefficients fit on select n = 4; the pinned test is untestable (no open values in the select window)

exploratory_refit.label: EXPLORATORY and NOT the pinned primary statistic: the pinned select window (<= 2022-11-11) has no open values, so the pinned test is untestable; coefficients here are fit on validation rows that carry open values. Never a verdict input.

intraday_2026.definition: main-line rung = ladder rung whose over (totals) or home-side (spreads) midpoint is nearest 50 percent at each snapshot. These are Polymarket-lineage ladder quotes, NOT ESPN lines. Movement = last pre-kickoff main rung minus first observed main rung.

pinned_parameters.kickoff: earlier of the ESPN base-row start and the Polymarket event start; observed_at < kickoff

market_quotes_db_reconciliation.role: reconciliation only: the DB carries no market slug and no team, so it cannot separate full-game from quarter/half ladders or orient spreads; it is not used for any number below

event_match.match_rule: both team names must match (exact or word-boundary prefix of the ESPN name, or an explicit alias) and the kickoffs must be within 6 hours; exactly one base row must qualify

agreement_with_espn_close.scope: events with a defined movement; the last snapshot's main rung vs the ESPN selected close

outcome_comparison.label: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: Polymarket-lineage ladder quotes, not ESPN lines

notes: ESPN movement is a close-time, untimestamped value: at most UPPER_BOUND_PASS, never enters v6.1.
Intraday ladders are Polymarket-lineage quotes, not ESPN lines; DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.
2026-11-14 games are post-holdout and are never scored in any outcome statistic here.
A non-final run reads no holdout row: verdicts that depend on the holdout are PROVISIONAL_PENDING_FINAL.
